work.author: Congregation for Divine Worship and the Discipline of the Sacraments
work.description: The Congregation's responses of 4 December 2021 to eleven questions on the application of Traditionis custodes, with explanatory notes, published after Francis approved publication on 18 November 2021, including the conditions for use of parish churches, the restriction of the older Pontificale and Rituale, and the treatment of priests who deny the validity and legitimacy of the liturgical reform.
